entities.summary: Denis Vladimirovich Gurianov is a Russian professional ice hockey winger for HC CSKA Moscow of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the first round, 12th overall, by the Dallas Stars in the 2015 NHL Entry Draft. Gurianov has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Montreal Canadiens, Nashville Predators and Philadelphia Flyers.
